compiled.draft: Life-critical health messages held by a filter must reach a second human reviewer within the deadline of their clinical tier, as declared by the authenticated sender.
compiled.rationale: The provision requires that life-critical health messages, which are authenticated, should bypass content-based scoring and be reviewed within a time limit specified by their clinical tier.
